product_metadata.title: TAO CICADA Cereal Bowls - Set of 4 Wheat Straw Fiber Bowls，Unbreakable & Lightweight for Snacks, Rice, Condiments, Side Dishes, or Ice Cream, Dishwasher & Microwave Safe
features: Healthy Material****Made of eco friendly natural wheat straw, starch and food safe PP material; BPA FREE, odorless and environmentally friendly, contains no plastic or wax lining.Mom can give the baby peace of mind to use the wheat straw bowl.

STYLISH DESIGN****Our set fits perfectly with all kinds of kitchen decor，Including 4 different clean colors: serenity blue, mint green, cream white, rose quartz. Colorful design with smooth round edges brings much fun for toddlers to eat, together with a classic round look for adults to enjoy them too.
LIGHTWEIGHT AND DURABLE****Our bowls are light to hold, they are unbreakable, chip resistance, no worry about falling down. A good alternative to glass, silicone and ceramic bowls.

MULTIPLE USES****Deep enough for cereal bowls, salad, fruit, rice or noodle without splashed out and spend some leisurely meal time. Great for parties, picnic, camping, and everyday meals at home, school, office, outdoor or traveling. A good choice for business promotional gifts and festival gifts!

MICROWAVE & DISHWASHER SAFE****This product very easy to clean, you can wash them with soap in hot water.The temperature resistance reaches up to 248 degrees Fahrenheit (120℃), in Microwave heating time does not exceed 3 minutes.
